A waterhole for all to meet that happen to also make good food
Aug 2025 • Friends
After two weeks in Vietnam I was hungering for some western style food and after walking down Dong Khoi road spotted this pub/bar. A pleasant atmosphere and a calming vibe allows patrons to listen to music that is not overwhelming and discuss their Vietnam experiences. The food was cooked as per request (medium steak) and in a timely manner. For a meal of just a drink away from the hustle and bustle of Nguyen Hue drive, this is a great option to sit with collegues and strategise your movements in Nam.
Read more
Insider tip:
They have half price Steak Nights on Thursday, Friday and Saturday
